purpose: Bounded exploratory census of native movement and recurrent recurrence in original agents; no learned-ring claim from heading turns alone.
native_settings: Exact original checkpoint including critic, native six actions/stochastic actor, native maps/goal snapshots/reward/noise; paired evaluation layouts and nonstaggered full episodes.
goal_message: Native saved actual-hit code preserved throughout each episode; zero only before discovery or episode reset.
intervention_scope: Only current-code slots256:768; native goal slots768:1280 unchanged.169 selected PGC channels; Grid substitution exactidentity.
saved_arrays: Actual1287-dimensional RNN inputs (including native CNN embedding), full512-dimensional incoming/outgoingh/c, logits/value/actions/uniforms, predecision and preteleport physical states, all hit/reset flags, environment RNG perstep and full runtime counters; no rawRGB archive.

cycle_definition.segmentation: Start at episode reset; each native hit ends a segment before teleport. Search and postdiscovery returns are labeled separately. Episodeend closes a right-censored segment.
cycle_definition.body_heading: Integrate wrapped predecision-to-preteleport heading deltas inside segment. Count each first passage of a new signed2pi level; recrossings do not add cycles.
cycle_definition.travel_direction: Report separate actual mDir winding and fraction of steps above native movement threshold; never call it bodyheading.
cycle_definition.eligibility: All128episodes and every segment retained; missing fullturns count0. No neural-outcome selection.
cycle_definition.recurrence: For every completed bodyheading turn, record physical closure and full-state neural closure divided by within-cycle RMS radius, separately raw and block-RMS coordinates. No PCA-based ring label.
cycle_definition.physical_usefulness: Report goal counts, return success/censoring, distanceprogress/pathlength, time-to-hit and cycle counts; compare descriptors by cycle presence, without causal interpretation.
cycle_definition.candidate_for_later_perturbation: At least2completed same-sign bodyheading turns within one segment identifies a repeated movement opportunity. Every such opportunity retained; no numerical ring/attractor conclusion or automatic expansion.

source_freeze: Separate exact runtime source manifest after focused implementation tests and before any native episode collection.
